requiredFindings.title: The busy-fence row puts PROJECT.BUSY in the D9 error-code column
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The installation fence is busy. The table emits PROJECT.BUSY as the D9 error code under class "refused". PROJECT.BUSY is a domain detail, not a D9ErrorCode. S12 routes that refusal to operational-failed, exit 4, error code LEDGER.BUSY_TIMEOUT, fault cause ledger-busy, detail PROJECT.BUSY. The envelope is not a valid operational-failed termination.

requiredFindings.title: The budget row pairs HOST.IO_FAILURE with fault cause host-invariant
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The admission ledger refuses a charge. The table says operational-failed, exit 4, error code HOST.IO_FAILURE, detail WORK.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, fault cause host-invariant. The fault map pairs host-invariant only with SYSTEM.OUTCOME.ILLEGAL_STATE, and HOST.IO_FAILURE only with host-io. The termination fails validation, or, if the fault cause is changed to host-io so it validates, a ledger cap is reported as an I/O failure.

priorFindings.r1: RF-1 closed. RF-2 closed except the busy-fence column and the budget error-code/fault-cause pair, which are this review's findings.
